endorsements.name: Antonio José Gálvez Sánchez
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-1868
endorsements.description: Vulnerability of unauthorized exposure of confidential information affecting Advanced IP Scanner and Advanced Port Scanner. It occurs when these applications initiate a network scan, inadvertently sending the NTLM hash of the user performing the scan. This vulnerability can be exploited by intercepting network traffic to a legitimate server or by setting up a fake server, in both local and remote scenarios. This exposure is relevant for both HTTP/HTTPS and SMB protocols.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 6.9)
